notes.title: Pakinpaks Demo Now Available!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The first public demo for Pakinpaks is finally here![/p][p][/p][p]You can now play through [b]5 levels[/b] in total from 2 different biomes. Complete the Client Requests to unlock [b]customization options for BonBon[/b], and continue to play procedurally generated levels in the [b]infinite mode[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We're really looking forward to your feedback, as we'll take all of it into account as development continues. You can [url="https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx"]join our Discord[/url] or use the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2707950/discussions/"]Steam Discussions forum[/url] to leave your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also taking part in two amazing festivals, [b]Wholesome Games Celebration[/b] and [b]Tiny Teams[/b]. Huge thanks to the Wholesome Games and Yogscast teams for organizing these events, and including us! You can click the buttons below to check out all the great games included in the festivals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568768/a6111a60170668e70565dd8b2995ab5a46cc8b20.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames" style="button"]Wholesome Games Celebration 2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568768/99081485c0da6f6707ef152528f2d6a91a6a22cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/423471/sale/tinyteams2025" style="button"]Tiny Teams 2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you all have fun![/p]
